testcase.name: Scenario: Navigate the available command list with the keyboard: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:773:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Navigate the available command list with the keyboard ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Ribbon customization dialog shows All Commands and an empty Part Tools target ✔ And the available command list is in its observed ascending order ✔ When the user selects "2D Sketches" in the available command list ✔ And the user presses End ✔ Then the list scrolls to its end and selects "Zoom Window" ✔ When the user presses Home ✔ Then the list scrolls to its beginning and selects "<Separator>" ✔ And Apply remains disabled ✔ When the user presses "Z" ✔ Then the list scrolls to and selects "Z Parallel" ✔ And the custom panel list remains empty ✔ And the target has no pending-change marker ✔ When the user clicks Close ✔ Then the customization dialog closes
